messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, I need those transferred. Albuterol and... Zoloft.
AGENT: I need to check with Brightway in Columbus to request those prescriptions. Can you give me the store address or location details for the Brightway you're using? That way I can make sure we're requesting from the right one.
CALLER: Oh wait, it's the sertraline, same thing. And yeah, the Brightway on High Street, I think.
AGENT: Got it—so you need the albuterol and sertraline transferred from the Brightway on High Street in Columbus. Let me find that store so I can request the transfer. I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in Columbus in our system. Do you happen to know the full address, or is there another detail about the location—like a cross street or zip code—that might help me track it down?  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: I don't know the address, man, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
AGENT (LATEST): I understand—unfortunately I can only search our system, and I'm not finding a Brightway in Columbus by that name. Since Brightway is a different pharmacy chain, I won't be able to request the transfer directly from here.

Here's what you can do: call the Brightway on High Street in Columbus and ask them to transfer your albuterol and sertraline to Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview. They'll have your prescription records and can send them over to us. Once they do, we'll have them ready for you.

CONDITIONS:
move_2: the agent starts or confirms transferring the albuterol; or, failing that, before the final read-back
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him)"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent gives a final read-back of sertraline only, B-4471 to H-302, and confirms the transfer has been requested.
stop_2: Agent says the transfer could not be done and gives a next step.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent said it cannot request transfer directly, not confirming."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask for old store phone number."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask for a phone number."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No read-back or confirmation of transfer request occurred."}, "stop_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent states transfer can't be done here, gives next steps."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of hanging up or calling 911."}}
